CVDs are leading causes of mortality in India and that evidence-based policy interventions for their prevention and control can substantially reduce their burden.
CVD prevention and control in India requires a comprehensive approach that involves policy makers, healthcare providers and the general public.
the policy initiatives for control of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in India have been proposed, but there is limited evidence on their effectiveness.

the following questions: What are the major policy initiatives for CVD control in India? What is the evidence of effectiveness of these policy initiatives? What are the challenges in translating evidence of effectiveness into effective policy?
